provenance.language: English prompts with Chinese learning explanations
provenance.note: Original fixed-choice practice. No external or human review is claimed; this pack is not an official IELTS test and does not estimate an IELTS band.

exercises.prompt: The new safety course will be added ___ the curriculum next term.
exercises.explanation: add something to the curriculum 表示“把某项内容加入课程体系”。此处使用被动结构 be added to。
exercises.hint: 想一想“把某物加入一个整体”的介词搭配。

exercises.prompt: She was awarded a scholarship ___ academic excellence.
exercises.explanation: a scholarship for academic excellence 指“因学业优异而获得的奖学金”；for 引出授予原因。
exercises.hint: 空格后说明获得奖学金的原因。

exercises.prompt: Each student's progress is ___ at the end of the course.
exercises.explanation: progress 是被评估的对象，is 后接过去分词 assessed，构成被动语态。assessment 是名词。
exercises.hint: 判断 progress 是动作的执行者还是承受者。

exercises.prompt: The new plan aims to make food production more ___.
exercises.explanation: make + 宾语 + 形容词表示“使……具有某种状态”，因此使用 sustainable。sustainably 是副词，sustainability 是名词。
exercises.hint: 这里需要说明 food production 变成什么状态。

exercises.prompt: The factory has installed equipment to ___ less carbon dioxide.
exercises.explanation: 这里的 to 引出目的，后接动词原形 emit。emission 是名词；emit carbon dioxide 表示“排放二氧化碳”。
exercises.hint: equipment 后的 to 表示目的。

exercises.prompt: Local volunteers play a key role ___ wildlife conservation.
exercises.explanation: play a role in something 表示“在某事中发挥作用”；wildlife conservation 指野生动物保护。
exercises.hint: 这里考查 play a role 后连接活动或领域的搭配。

exercises.prompt: The award recognises the most ___ design submitted this year.
exercises.explanation: design 是名词，需要形容词 innovative 修饰；the most innovative design 意为“最有创新性的设计”。
exercises.hint: 空格直接修饰 design，并与 the most 一起构成最高级。

exercises.prompt: The council plans to invest ___ transport infrastructure.
exercises.explanation: invest in something 表示“投资于某事物”；transport infrastructure 指交通基础设施。
exercises.hint: 想一想 invest 表示“投资于”时的介词。

exercises.prompt: The storage area is kept ___ constant video surveillance.
exercises.explanation: under surveillance 是固定搭配，表示“处于监控之下”；video surveillance 指视频监控。
exercises.hint: 需要表达“处于监控之下”的状态。

exercises.prompt: The policy aims to protect applicants ___ prejudice in hiring.
exercises.explanation: protect someone from something 表示“保护某人免受……影响”；此处指使求职者免受招聘偏见的影响。
exercises.hint: 后面的 prejudice 是需要避免受到的伤害。

exercises.prompt: The report describes recent ___ changes in the region.
exercises.explanation: changes 是名词，应由形容词 demographic 修饰。demographic changes 指人口结构方面的变化。
exercises.hint: 空格修饰名词 changes。

exercises.prompt: The proposed legislation will come ___ force in July.
exercises.explanation: come into force 表示法律、规定等“开始生效”。legislation 在这里指拟议的法律。
exercises.hint: 题意是法律将在七月“生效”。

exercises.prompt: The course teaches students to assess meals ___, rather than only by price.
exercises.explanation: 副词 nutritionally 修饰 assess，说明从营养角度评估饭菜；nutritional 是形容词，nutrition 是名词。
exercises.hint: 空格说明“从什么角度评估”，修饰 assess。

exercises.prompt: The report compares three different ___ for the same set of symptoms.
exercises.explanation: three different 后需要复数名词。diagnosis 的复数是不规则形式 diagnoses；diagnose 是动词。
exercises.hint: 留意 three，以及 diagnosis 的复数形式。

exercises.prompt: The study focuses on patients who suffer ___ chronic back pain.
exercises.explanation: suffer from a condition 表示“患有某种病症或受到其困扰”；chronic back pain 指长期背痛。
exercises.hint: 这里要连接 suffer 和具体病症。

exercises.prompt: The scheme offers several small ___ to local farms.
exercises.explanation: several 后需要可数名词复数。subsidy 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，复数改 y 为 ies，成为 subsidies。
exercises.hint: several 决定这里应使用单数还是复数。

exercises.prompt: The report records household expenditure ___ transport.
exercises.explanation: expenditure on something 表示“在某方面的支出”；household expenditure on transport 指家庭交通支出。
exercises.hint: 空格后是支出的具体用途。

exercises.prompt: Staff can work more ___ when they have the right tools.
exercises.explanation: work 是动词，应用副词 productively 修饰，表示“更有效率地工作”；productivity 是名词“生产效率”。
exercises.hint: 空格修饰动作 work。

exercises.prompt: The researchers tested two competing ___.
exercises.explanation: two 后需要复数名词。hypothesis 的复数是 hypotheses；hypothesise 是动词，hypothetical 是形容词。
exercises.hint: 这里考查 hypothesis 的复数形式。

exercises.prompt: The study found a correlation ___ commute length and job satisfaction.
exercises.explanation: a correlation between A and B 表示“A 与 B 之间的相关性”。相关性本身并不说明因果关系。
exercises.hint: 这里明确列出了 A and B 两个变量。

exercises.prompt: A second laboratory will ___ the experiment using the same procedure.
exercises.explanation: 情态动词 will 后接动词原形 replicate。replicate an experiment 表示按相同程序重复实验。
exercises.hint: will 后的动词应采用什么形式？

exercises.prompt: The dancers wore ___ costumes during the festival.
exercises.explanation: costumes 是名词，应由形容词 traditional 修饰；traditional costumes 表示“传统服饰”。
exercises.hint: 需要用形容词说明 costumes 的特点。

exercises.prompt: The company gives staff more ___ in choosing their working hours.
exercises.explanation: give someone more flexibility 表示“给某人更大的灵活性”。这里需要名词 flexibility，后接 in doing something 说明具体方面。
exercises.hint: give staff more 后需要表示“灵活性”的名词。

exercises.prompt: The museum developed the exhibition in collaboration ___ local artists.
exercises.explanation: in collaboration with someone 表示“与某人合作”。with 后接合作伙伴。
exercises.hint: local artists 是合作伙伴。
